The '''Groin popper''' was a close combat maneuver. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]] used this maneuver against [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], which dislocated his leg.
